strings.url.format_tip:
Format: scheme://user:***@host:port/database
Examples: mysql://user:***@db.example.com:3306/app
mongodb://user:***@db.example.com:27017/app?authSource=auth
Use the help inside the dialog for all supported formats.
strings.url.format_rules: Replace user, ***, db.example.com and app with your own values. *** is a masked password placeholder, not a usable password. Percent-encode reserved characters in credentials (for example @ as %40). IPv6 addresses use brackets. One URL per line; unknown options are rejected explicitly. MongoDB authSource is independent of the target database. SRV/multiple hosts are not supported yet. In @tcp(...) DSN-style URLs, credentials follow Go DSN rules and are not URL-decoded.
strings.url.format_examples:
MySQL: mysql://user:***@db.example.com:3306/app
MariaDB: mariadb://user:***@db.example.com:3306/app
PostgreSQL: postgresql://user:***@db.example.com:5432/app
Redis: redis://user:***@db.example.com:6379/0
Redis TLS: rediss://user:***@db.example.com:6380/0
ClickHouse: clickhouse://user:***@db.example.com:8123/app
MongoDB: mongodb://user:***@db.example.com:27017/app?authSource=auth
Go MySQL DSN-style URL: mysql://user:***@tcp(db.example.com:3306)/app?interpolateParams=true&charset=utf8mb4&parseTime=True&loc=Local

strings.accounts.workbench.grant_database_all: Grant all privileges on this database
strings.accounts.workbench.grant_database_hint: Stage database-wide privileges, including future tables and database routines. Existing grants are preserved; new grants cannot be delegated. Preview and confirm before applying.
strings.accounts.workbench.bulk_staged: Database privileges staged. Preview SQL and confirm to apply.
strings.notes.title_file_hint: File: {filename}. Only the display title changes; the connection address is shown automatically.
strings.notes.export_connections_hint: This Note uses multiple connections. Choose one to export its SQL cells only; cells from other connections will be excluded, even if database names match. SQL is not executed.
strings.notes.export_missing_connection: Connection unavailable — assign a saved connection to these cells.
strings.notes.export_filtered: {count} SQL cells from other connections excluded. To export them, start export again and choose their connection.
strings.indexes.title: Indexes
strings.indexes.name: Index name
strings.indexes.limit: Loaded 20,000 indexes. Narrow the database scope.
strings.indexes.choose_table: Select an index to choose its table, or open indexes from a table.
strings.indexes.protected: Primary, unique, system or foreign-key-related indexes are protected. Where dependency metadata is incomplete, existing indexes on foreign-key tables are read-only. Review the table DDL.
strings.indexes.rebuild_hint: Edits generate DROP + CREATE with the selected columns. Advanced index options are not copied. Review uniqueness, locking and server-version support before execution.
strings.indexes.staged: Index change staged. Generate SQL to review; nothing was executed.
strings.indexes.preview_hint: Preview only. DROP/CREATE may lock or rebuild tables. Copy or save, verify the target and current structure, then explicitly execute in Note.
strings.indexes.unsupported: This driver supports index browsing only. Use its native DDL to design changes.
strings.indexes.invalid: Enter a valid index name and choose distinct existing columns.
strings.indexes.duplicate: An index with this name already exists. Choose another name.
strings.indexes.choose_table_title: Choose a table for the new index
strings.compare.cancelled: Comparison cancelled. No database changes were made.
strings.compare.wait_pair: Waiting for both table definitions; unloaded metadata is not a missing table.
strings.indexes.read_only: This connection is read-only. Index design is unavailable; no SQL was executed.
strings.compare.identical: The structures match. Show all attributes to inspect them.
strings.compare.no_match: No matching attributes. Adjust the object or field filter.
strings.compare.issue.parse_column: Column {column} could not be fully parsed; other supported changes are included.
